flog.definition: v. beat severely with a whip or rod
flog.translation: vt. 鞭打, 鞭策, 严厉的批评, 迫使

flogged.translation: v. 滥用( flog的过去式和过去分词 ); <非正>出售; 多次重打; 鞭策死马

flogger.definition:
n. One who flogs.
n. A kind of mallet for beating the bung stave of a cask to
   start the bung.

floggers.definition:
plural of flogger
n. One who flogs.
n. A kind of mallet for beating the bung stave of a cask to
   start the bung.

flogging.definition:
n beating with a whip or strap or rope as a form of punishment
v beat severely with a whip or rod
v beat with a cane
flogging.translation:
n. 鞭打
[机] 击落浇冒口

floggings.definition:
plural of flogging
n beating with a whip or strap or rope as a form of punishment
v beat severely with a whip or rod
v beat with a cane
floggings.translation:
(flogging 的复数) n. 鞭打
[机] 击落浇冒口

flogs.definition:
v beat severely with a whip or rod
v beat with a cane
flogs.translation: v. 滥用( flog的第三人称单数 ); <非正>出售; 多次重打; 鞭策死马
